about.title: Empowering Entrepreneurs
about.body1: For over a decade, Menara Office has helped Indonesian SMEs and startups run a professional office without the burden of expensive building leases.
about.body2: From prestigious business addresses and move-in-ready workspaces to PT & CV incorporation, we are the growth partner of thousands of businesses across Jakarta, Bekasi, and Bandung.
about.mission1Body: Every address sits in a commercial zone and is legally valid as a registered company domicile.
about.mission2Body: Clear packages with no hidden fees, upgradeable as your business grows.
about.mission3Body: Receptionists, office support, and certified legal consultants at every location.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can a virtual office address be used to incorporate a PT?
faq.a1: Yes. Every Menara Office location sits in a commercial zone, making it legally valid as the registered domicile for a PT, sole-proprietor PT, or CV.
faq.q2: How fast is virtual office activation?
faq.a2: Once documents are complete and payment is received, your address is active the same business day, including mail handling and receptionist service.
faq.q3: How do I book a meeting room?
faq.a3: Use the Booking page on this website: pick a location, date, and available time, then send the request. Our team confirms via WhatsApp.
faq.a4: No. Package prices cover all listed facilities. Any additional needs are always communicated upfront.
faq.q5: Can I upgrade my plan mid-term?
faq.a5: Yes. You can switch plans or add services at any time. The difference is calculated pro rata.
